 November 12, 2026 
 GTA 6 & YouTube Collaborate For Big 24-Hour Livestream
 GTA 6 is the biggest video game ever, so it makes sense to give people ‘the biggest livestream.’ YouTube carries on Grand Theft Auto 6’s incredible marketing campaign with a can’t-miss streaming event.
 If you’re not playing GTA 6 , or even if you are, it might be cool to check out YouTube ‘s launch day livestream, featuring 24 hours of continuous action featuring a plethora of streamers and content creators.
 YouTube & GTA 6 Livestream For 24 Hours Straight
 Credit to Rockstar Games 
 ‘The biggest launch of all time deserves the biggest livestream. 24 hours. 11/18. 11pm ET. YouTube.’
 More Insider Gaming: Full GTA 6 Map Leaked Online From Collector’s Box 
 This is what YouTube has said and is offering. A link to the livestream is already up, and it has a one-minute trailer for the event. Countless creators are shown, and the X announcement has revealed many of the streamers for it:

 The YouTube description also added: ‘We’re counting down the minutes until Launch Day: YouTube’s 24 Hour GTAVI Live Stream. Set your reminders now and tune in live on November 18th @ 11P ET for our pre-show kickoff.’
 Expect 24 hours of pure GTA 6 chaos, screaming, viral clips, and much more of what you’d expect from some of the world’s most popular streamers.
 Will you be tuning in? Let us know your thoughts via the  free Insider Gaming Discord server .
 For more Insider Gaming content, read ‘ XBOX CEO Asha Sharma’s Full Memo on ’25 YEARS OF XBOX’ .’ Don’t forget to  sign up for our free weekly newsletter .
